summary: Rates page and About page read live via headless browser (406 to curl). Confirmed the 2026 rate table AWH ruled on (keep with the confusing-pricing caveat; note kept), 54 sites, 30 A, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums (holiday added), showers/laundry/store, opens May 15. Extra person $6 (2 adults + 2 children included) added. Waterfront lead: operator map puts sites 34-43 on a 'Camping Beach' along the shoreline - canopy hides them on imagery, stored not waterfront kept.
flags: PRICE (AWH 2026-11-17 ruling stands, re-read 2026-11-20): rates page still 'Rates and Reservations - 2026' with sites $36/$39 and the separate '30-amp Service and Camping/Travel Trailers... $45.00 / over 20' ... add $6.00' line. Google 4.8 over 52.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (operator claim vs stored 'not waterfront'): the operator's site map draws sites 34-43 in a row labelled 'CAMPING BEACH' directly above 'Shoreline - 3000'', and sites 27-33 down a peninsula along the water; the About page says '3100 feet of scenic shoreline' and 'Three Beautiful Beaches for Swimming, Camping and Boating'. Esri imagery shows only continuous canopy plus a grassy clearing / sandy spot on the west shore (~45.9243,-89.9510); no pads can be placed, so nothing is changed (defaults down). Sites 34-43 sell at $39 and are bookable by the night. Would need a site photo or a leaf-off image to rate.

SAND RULE (flag only): the map's 'CAMPING BEACH' (sites 34-43) may be beach camping; it is part of a developed loop with a service building, so it reads as 'a developed loop that merely also offers beach camping' - stays.

LONG-STAY: 'Seasonal Rates are available' - nightly share not measurable; the 2026 page prices all 54 sites by the night and reviews read are family vacations ('My family has been coming here for almost 50 years'). Not read as mostly seasonal.
REVIEW: one Google review says 'Carolyn doesn't get back to you ... We have called, emailed, and filled out' (booking responsiveness).
Site count: About page (footer (c)2020) says '45 Wooded Campsites' vs 54 numbered sites on the 2026 rates page and site map - 54 kept.
